name: 01505 · Boylston, MA
findings: ZIP 01505 (Boylston) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01505 (Boylston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 01505 (Boylston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 21% of all organizations here have no identified type.
